patch.note: max-filtered over one bake texel then smoothed twice; sample with Catmull-Rom (bench_walk_path.ground)

segments.name: spawn_basin
segments.why: the scene's own walker spawn — the reference location, kept so this tour stays comparable with the single-basin bench

segments.name: dense_near
segments.why: most trees within 300 m of any walkable low-elevation cell — the heaviest near-field instanced draw on the map

segments.name: dense_deep
segments.why: most trees inside the 1250 m impostor radius — the deepest forest column, near-field cost plus the largest far-instance set

segments.name: sparse_open
segments.why: FEWEST trees within 300 m while still surrounded by forest at distance — the map's plantable band has no true clearing, so this is its open ground

segments.name: slope_treed
segments.why: the biggest relief inside 100 m that a walker can still climb, with trees on it — the ground-following leg

segments.name: ridge_view
segments.why: highest prominence over its 1 km neighbourhood that still sits under the cloud deck and above forest — the long view out

segments.name: gorge_occluded
segments.why: deepest cell relative to its 1 km neighbourhood — the terrain-occluded opposite of the ridge, where most of the map is hidden

segments.name: treeline_edge
segments.why: sharpest forest/bare boundary — half the sweep looks into canopy, half into open rock, in one location
